name: Emby Now Playing (Live TV & DVR)
description: Emby now playing with Live TV awareness: shows the program airing on a channel (title, episode, time slot, progress), recordings still in progress, DVR/VOD tags, remux vs real transcode with a hover reason, HDR/DV and audio format, avatars, channel logos, optional posters and an optional Stop button. Uses your existing Emby integration; viewers need full access to it, so it won't show on public boards for guests.

showOverview.label: Show description
showOverview.description: Also print a two-line summary under the title. Off by default; the summary is always available by hovering the episode line.

titleArt.label: Title artwork
titleArt.description: Icons shows a film, TV or music icon. Posters shows the movie or series poster in its own column next to the title. Live TV and DVR show the channel logo there. Posters need Emby URL; items without a poster keep the icon.

showStop.label: Show Stop button
showStop.description: Adds a small Stop button next to each stream's play method. It asks to confirm first. Stopping runs a Homarr action, so it only works for users who can edit the board.

maxStreams.label: Max streams shown
maxStreams.description: Extra streams still count in the footer but aren't listed. 12 is the maximum because Homarr limits how much one widget can render.

dvrPaths.label: DVR recording folders
dvrPaths.description: Comma-separated folder paths as Emby sees them, e.g. /recordings. Items from these get a DVR tag. Leave empty to turn off.

vodPaths.label: On-demand (VOD) folders
vodPaths.description: Comma-separated folder paths as Emby sees them, e.g. /vod-movies, /vod-tv. Items from these get a VOD tag. Leave empty to turn off.

tailscaleLabel.label: Label Tailscale connections
tailscaleLabel.description: Show 'Tailscale' instead of 'WAN' for clients in 100.64.0.0/10 or fd7a:115c:a1e0::/48. This is a best guess from the address; some ISPs use the same IPv4 range.

libraryColor.label: Library progress bar color
libraryColor.description: Color of the progress bar for regular library items. LIVE, DVR and VOD bars always match their tags.

embyUrl.label: Emby URL (for pictures and links)
embyUrl.description: Address you use to open Emby in your browser, e.g. https://emby.example.com (a /web/... ending is fine). Used for user avatars, channel logos, posters and title links. Use https if Homarr is on https. Leave empty for initials and icons only.

showBranding.label: Show Emby logo
showBranding.description: Show the Emby logo and name in the bottom-right corner.

template:
<Box h="100%">
{[(Array.isArray(data.sessions) ? data.sessions : [])
  .filter((s) => s.NowPlayingItem)
  .slice(0, Math.min(12, Number(options.maxStreams ?? 10) || 10))
  .map((s) => ({
    id: s.Id,
    user: s.UserName ?? "Unknown",
    avatar: s.UserId && s.UserPrimaryImageTag && options.embyUrl?.trim() ? options.embyUrl.trim().replace(/\/web\/.*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/web$/, "") + "/Users/" + s.UserId + "/Images/Primary?height=240&tag=" + s.UserPrimaryImageTag : "",
    device: (s.Client ?? "") + (s.DeviceName ? " (" + s.DeviceName + ")" : ""),
    item: s.NowPlayingItem,
    live: s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "TvChannel",
    prog: s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "TvChannel" ? s.NowPlayingItem.CurrentProgram : null,
    paused: s.PlayState?.IsPaused === true,
    method: s.PlayState?.PlayMethod ?? "",
    pos: s.PlayState?.PositionTicks ?? 0,
    ip: (s.RemoteEndPoint ?? "").replace(/^::ffff:/i, "").toLowerCase(),
    tx: s.PlayState?.PlayMethod === "Transcode" && s.TranscodingInfo ? s.TranscodingInfo : null,
    path: (s.NowPlayingItem.Path ?? "").toLowerCase(),
    oct: (s.RemoteEndPoint ?? "").replace(/^::ffff:/i, "").split(".").map((x) => Number(x)),
    rate: s.TranscodingInfo?.Bitrate ?? s.NowPlayingItem.Bitrate ?? 0,
    video: (s.NowPlayingItem.MediaStreams ?? []).filter((m) => m.Type === "Video")[0],
    audio: (s.NowPlayingItem.MediaStreams ?? []).filter((m) => m.Type === "Audio" && m.Index === s.PlayState?.AudioStreamIndex)[0] ?? (s.NowPlayingItem.MediaStreams ?? []).filter((m) => m.Type === "Audio")[0],
    href: options.embyUrl?.trim() && s.NowPlayingItem.Id ? options.embyUrl.trim().replace(/\/web\/.*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/web$/, "") + "/web/index.html#!/item?id=" + s.NowPlayingItem.Id + (s.ServerId ? "&serverId=" + s.ServerId : "") : "",
    logo: !options.embyUrl?.trim() ? ""
      : s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "TvChannel"
        ? [["LogoLightColor", "LogoLight", "Primary"].filter((k) => s.NowPlayingItem.ImageTags?.[k])[0]].map((k) => k ? options.embyUrl.trim().replace(/\/web\/.*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/web$/, "") + "/Items/" + s.NowPlayingItem.Id + "/Images/" + k + "?height=96&tag=" + s.NowPlayingItem.ImageTags[k] : "")[0]
        : s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "Recording" && s.NowPlayingItem.ChannelId && s.NowPlayingItem.ChannelPrimaryImageTag
          ? options.embyUrl.trim().replace(/\/web\/.*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/web$/, "") + "/Items/" + s.NowPlayingItem.ChannelId + "/Images/Primary?height=96&tag=" + s.NowPlayingItem.ChannelPrimaryImageTag
          : "",
    art: !options.embyUrl?.trim() || options.titleArt !== "posters" || s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "TvChannel" || s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "Recording" ? ""
      : [s.NowPlayingItem.SeriesId && s.NowPlayingItem.SeriesPrimaryImageTag ? [s.NowPlayingItem.SeriesId, s.NowPlayingItem.SeriesPrimaryImageTag] : s.NowPlayingItem.ImageTags?.Primary ? [s.NowPlayingItem.Id, s.NowPlayingItem.ImageTags.Primary] : s.NowPlayingItem.AlbumId && s.NowPlayingItem.AlbumPrimaryImageTag ? [s.NowPlayingItem.AlbumId, s.NowPlayingItem.AlbumPrimaryImageTag] : null]
        .map((a) => a ? options.embyUrl.trim().replace(/\/web\/.*$/, "").replace(/\/+$/, "").replace(/\/web$/, "") + "/Items/" + a[0] + "/Images/Primary?height=120&tag=" + a[1] : "")[0],
    desc: (s.NowPlayingItem.Type === "TvChannel" ? s.NowPlayingItem.CurrentProgram?.Overview : s.NowPlayingItem.Overview) ?? "",
  }))
  .map((v) => ({
    ...v,
    title: v.live
      ? (v.prog?.Name ?? v.item.Name)
      : (v.item.Type === "Episode" || (v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.ParentIndexNumber > 0))
        ? (v.item.SeriesName ?? v.item.Name)
        : v.item.Name,
    sub: v.live
      ? [v.item.Name + (v.item.ChannelNumber ? " · Ch " + v.item.ChannelNumber : ""), v.prog?.EpisodeTitle].filter((x) => x).join(" · ")
      : (v.item.Type === "Episode" || (v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.ParentIndexNumber > 0))
        ? "S" + ((v.item.ParentIndexNumber ?? 0) < 10 ? "0" : "") + (v.item.ParentIndexNumber ?? 0) + " E" + ((v.item.IndexNumber ?? 0) < 10 ? "0" : "") + (v.item.IndexNumber ?? 0) + " · " + (v.item.Type === "Recording" ? (v.item.EpisodeTitle ?? "") : v.item.Name)
        : v.item.MediaType === "Audio" ? [(v.item.Artists ?? []).join(", ") || v.item.AlbumArtist || "", v.item.Album ?? ""].filter((x) => x).join(" · ")
        : v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.EpisodeTitle ? v.item.EpisodeTitle : (v.item.ProductionYear ? "" + v.item.ProductionYear : ""),
    start: v.prog?.StartDate ? Date.create(v.prog.StartDate) : v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.StartDate ? Date.create(v.item.StartDate) : 0,
    end: v.prog?.EndDate ? Date.create(v.prog.EndDate) : v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.EndDate ? Date.create(v.item.EndDate) : 0,
    recNow: v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.Status === "InProgress",
    run: v.item.RunTimeTicks ?? (v.item.Type === "Recording" && v.item.StartDate && v.item.EndDate ? (Date.create(v.item.EndDate) - Date.create(v.item.StartDate)) * 10000 : 0),
    res: v.video?.Width >= 3200 || v.video?.Height >= 2000 ? "4K" : v.video?.Width >= 2400 || v.video?.Height >= 1400 ? "1440p" : v.video?.Width >= 1800 || v.video?.Height >= 1000 ? "1080p" : v.video?.Width >= 1200 || v.video?.Height >= 700 ? "720p" : v.video?.Height ? v.video.Height + "p" : "",
    hdr: [(v.video?.ExtendedVideoType && v.video.ExtendedVideoType !== "None" ? v.video.ExtendedVideoType : v.video?.VideoRange ?? "").toLowerCase()].map((x) => x.includes("dolby") ? "DV" : x.includes("10plus") || x.includes("10+") ? "HDR10+" : x.includes("hlg") ? "HLG" : x.includes("hdr") ? "HDR10" : "")[0],
    aud: v.audio || v.tx?.AudioCodec
      ? [v.tx && v.tx.IsAudioDirect !== true && v.tx.AudioCodec ? { c: v.tx.AudioCodec, n: v.tx.AudioChannels ?? 0, l: "", t: "" } : { c: v.audio?.Codec ?? "", n: v.audio?.Channels ?? 0, l: v.audio?.ChannelLayout ?? "", t: ((v.audio?.DisplayTitle ?? "") + " " + (v.audio?.Profile ?? "") + " " + (v.audio?.Title ?? "")).toLowerCase() }]
          .map((a) => [({ keac3: "DD+", kac3: "DD", ktruehd: "TrueHD", kdts: "DTS", kaac: "AAC", kflac: "FLAC", kopus: "Opus", kmp3: "MP3", kmp2: "MP2", kvorbis: "Vorbis" })["k" + a.c.toLowerCase()] ?? a.c.toUpperCase(), a.t.includes("atmos") ? "Atmos" : "", a.l === "stereo" || a.n === 2 ? "Stereo" : a.l === "mono" || a.n === 1 ? "Mono" : a.l ? a.l : a.n > 0 ? a.n + "ch" : ""].filter((x) => x).join(" "))[0]
      : "",
    net: v.ip.includes(":") ? (options.tailscaleLabel !== false && v.ip.startsWith("fd7a:115c:a1e0") ? "Tailscale" : v.ip === "::1" || v.ip.startsWith("fe80") || v.ip.startsWith("fc") || v.ip.startsWith("fd") ? "LAN" : "WAN") : options.tailscaleLabel !== false && v.oct[0] === 100 && v.oct[1] >= 64 && v.oct[1] <= 127 ? "Tailscale" : v.oct[0] === 10 || v.oct[0] === 127 || (v.oct[0] === 192 && v.oct[1] === 168) || (v.oct[0] === 172 && v.oct[1] >= 16 && v.oct[1] <= 31) ? "LAN" : "WAN",
    mb: Math.round(v.rate / 100000) / 10,
    icon: v.item.Type === "TvChannel" ? "device-tv" : v.item.Type === "Episode" || v.item.Type === "Recording" ? "device-tv-old" : v.item.MediaType === "Audio" ? "music" : "movie",
  }))
  .map((v) => ({
    ...v,
    pct: v.live
      ? (v.end > v.start ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, ((Date.now() - v.start) * 100) / (v.end - v.start))) : 0)
      : (v.run > 0 ? Math.min(100, (v.pos * 100) / v.run) : 0),
    left: v.live
      ? (v.end > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round((v.end - Date.now()) / 60000)) : -1)
      : v.recNow ? -1
      : (v.run > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round((v.run - v.pos) / 600000000)) : -1),
    slot: v.recNow && v.end > 0
      ? "Still recording · ends " + (options.timeFormat === "24h" ? Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.end, "en-GB").replace(/:\d\d$/, "") : Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.end, "en-US").replace(/:\d\d /, " "))
      : v.live && v.start > 0 && v.end > 0
      ? (options.timeFormat === "24h" ? Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.start, "en-GB").replace(/:\d\d$/, "") : Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.start, "en-US").replace(/:\d\d /, " ")) + " – " + (options.timeFormat === "24h" ? Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.end, "en-GB").replace(/:\d\d$/, "") : Date.toLocaleTimeString(v.end, "en-US").replace(/:\d\d /, " "))
      : "",
    tag: v.live ? "LIVE" : v.path && (options.dvrPaths ?? "").toLowerCase().split(",").map((p) => p.trim()).filter((p) => p && v.path.startsWith(p)).length > 0 ? "DVR" : v.path && (options.vodPaths ?? "").toLowerCase().split(",").map((p) => p.trim()).filter((p) => p && v.path.startsWith(p)).length > 0 ? "VOD" : "",
    vx: v.tx ? v.tx.IsVideoDirect !== true : false,
    ax: v.tx ? v.tx.IsAudioDirect !== true : false,
  }))
  .map((v) => ({
    ...v,
    badge: v.tx ? (v.vx && v.ax ? "TRANSCODE A/V" : v.vx ? "TRANSCODE VIDEO" : v.ax ? "TRANSCODE AUDIO" : "REMUX") : v.method === "DirectPlay" ? "DIRECT PLAY" : v.method === "DirectStream" ? "DIRECT STREAM" : v.method === "Transcode" ? "TRANSCODE" : v.method.toUpperCase(),
    hot: v.method === "Transcode" && (!v.tx || v.vx || v.ax),
    tip: v.tx
      ? ["Video: " + (v.vx ? "converted to " + (v.tx.VideoCodec ?? "?") + (v.tx.VideoEncoderIsHardware ? " (hardware)" : " (software)") : "copied" + (v.tx.VideoCodec ? " (" + v.tx.VideoCodec + ")" : "")),
         "Audio: " + (v.ax ? "converted to " + (v.tx.AudioCodec ?? "?") : "copied" + (v.tx.AudioCodec ? " (" + v.tx.AudioCodec + ")" : "")),
         (v.tx.TranscodeReasons ?? []).length > 0 ? "Why: " + (v.tx.TranscodeReasons ?? []).map((x) => x.replace(/([a-z])([A-Z])/g, "$1 $2").toLowerCase()).join(", ") : ""].filter((x) => x).join(" · ")
      : v.method === "DirectPlay" ? "Direct play: the file is sent as-is" : v.method === "DirectStream" ? "Direct stream: video and audio are sent as-is" : "",
  }))
].map((rows) => (
  <Stack gap={0} h="100%" p="xs" style={{ overflowY: "auto" }}>

"var(--mantine-color-violet-7)" : "var(--mantine-color-blue-7)", color: "white" }}>{r.tag}</Badge> : null}

The stream may have already ended, or you need permission to edit this board."><Icon name="player-stop-filled" size={14} /></ActionButton></Box> : null}

        {rows.length > 0 && !status.sessions?.loading && !status.sessions?.error && status.sessions?.ok !== false ? (
          <Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap" style={{ minWidth: 0 }}>
            <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" style={{ display: "inline-flex", flexShrink: 0 }}><Icon name="broadcast" size="1.3em" /></Text>
            <Text size="xs" c="dimmed" truncate="end">{[(Array.isArray(data.sessions) ? data.sessions : []).filter((s) => s.NowPlayingItem)].map((all) => all.length + (all.length === 1 ? " active stream" : " active streams") + (all.length > rows.length ? " (+" + (all.length - rows.length) + " more not shown)" : "") + " · Total " + Math.round(all.reduce((a, x) => a + (x.TranscodingInfo?.Bitrate ?? x.NowPlayingItem.Bitrate ?? 0), 0) / 100000) / 10 + " Mb/s")[0]}</Text>
          </Group>
        ) : <Box />}
        {options.showBranding !== false ? (
          <Group gap={6} wrap="nowrap" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
            <Image src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/homarr-labs/dashboard-icons/svg/emby.svg" alt="Emby" w={18} h={18} fit="contain" />
            <Text size="sm" fw={500}>Emby</Text>
          </Group>
        ) : null}
      </Group>
    ) : null}
  </Stack>
))[0]}
</Box>
